listings.title: Format JSON
listings.description: Pretty-print JSON and sort object keys.
listings.dataAccess: Reads clipboard text, shows the result, and replaces the clipboard. No network requests.

listings.title: Count Words
listings.dataAccess: Reads clipboard text and shows counts in Ting. No network requests.
listings.requirements: macOS command-line tools: wc and awk.

listings.title: Sort Selected Lines
listings.description: Sort lines in the current text selection.
listings.dataAccess: Reads selected text and pastes sorted lines back into the front app. No network requests.
listings.requirements: Accessibility permission, an editable selection, and macOS sort.

listings.title: Copy Page Link
listings.description: Copy the front browser tab as a Markdown link.
listings.dataAccess: Reads the tab title and URL and writes a link to the clipboard. No network requests.
listings.requirements: A supported browser with an open tab and Automation permission for that browser.

listings.title: Finder Checksum
listings.description: Show SHA-256 checksums for files selected in Finder.
listings.dataAccess: Reads the selected paths and file contents, and shows hashes in Ting. No network requests.
listings.requirements: Automation permission for Finder, readable files, and macOS shasum.
